race.description: Riverina Livestock Agents Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BETTER BLOOM (5) failed to justify the short quote at Gundagai last week but backs up quickly and is still improving. Gets her chance to put it all together third-up. BRILLIANT BULL ANT (4) finds the maiden win elusive but it certainly hasn't been without trying and might've found his best chance yet. Has been powering home late, so if he can settle closer this time he will take plenty of stopping.  MR REIBY (2) went close to making the perfect start at Moruya on debut but couldn't quite follow it up at Kembla Grange last time. Suspect this is a bit easier. Fitter and looks the main danger. MASAKARI (1) was prominent in betting when fresh from a spell last start but could only manage to finish sixth over 1200m at Wodonga. Was in the placings at his only other second-up run. Goes well at this distance, filling a placing at all four runs and is sure to be thereabouts.
